key.name: stay-on-top
key.summary: Keep the window above other windows
key.description: Applied by the SysMo Gauges GNOME Shell extension, which must be enabled.

key.name: cooler-display
key.summary: Show CPU readings on a DeepCool cooler's display

key.name: cooler-fahrenheit
key.summary: Show °F instead of °C on the cooler's display

key.name: fan-header
key.summary: Fan header of the CPU fan
key.description: hwmon chip name and channel, for example "nct6799:2". Empty picks one automatically.

key.name: fan-fixed
key.summary: Hold the CPU fan at a fixed speed instead of motherboard control

key.name: fan-percent
key.summary: Fixed CPU fan speed in percent

key.name: fan-auto-mode
key.description: The fan header's pwm_enable value before SysMo took control; written back when SysMo hands the fan back.

key.name: section-states
key.summary: Expanded or collapsed state of each section
key.description: Entries of the form "section-id:expanded" or "section-id:collapsed". Sections without an entry use their default state.
